runs.name: Outokumpu Oyj; Finland, Nasdaq Helsinki OUT1V, not an SEC registrant (EDGAR holds only the ADR facility's F-6EF filings, the latest 2023-12-11), OTC ADR one ADS to one-half share; three business areas, Europe, the Americas and Ferrochrome; no rename, merger, spin-off or split seen; the EUR 125M convertible converted into 47.0M new shares in 2025; the company's reports name Aperam and Acerinox (read from their own releases, not SEC filers) and Cleveland-Cliffs and ATI (not read)
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **EUR 5.015** (Nasdaq Helsinki OUT1V, 2026-10-13; Yahoo chart, aggregator, flagged; the ADR OUTKY **US$ 2.81**, one ADS to one-half share per the 2023-12-11 F-6EF). Shares **471,377,716** outstanding, one class (issued 473,016,832 less treasury 1,639,116, half-year report 2026-07-30); cap **EUR 2,364M**. Sovereign **3.76%** (ECB 30-year spot, 2026-10-12). Filings read, from the company: the 2025 Review by the Board of Directors with the financial statements (PwC, 2026-02-25), the 2026 Q1 and half-year reports, the year-end releases 2016 to 2025; one figure cross-checked (2025 operating cash flow EUR 79M, release and audited statement). `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned not an SEC filer; arithmetic by hand. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the Board review and the notes (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. Q1 IN. **Q2 OUT**: no part carries half of 2021 to 2025 reported EBIT; Europe decides at EUR 580M (34.4%) against the Americas 565M and Ferrochrome 540M, a knife edge (on adjusted EBIT the Americas would decide; both castles recorded, both open); Europe a high-cost producer in a commodity field whose price Asian imports set in the filer's words, EU share 31% to 28% in 2025 as imports rose 22% to 25%, EBIT (31), (52), (233) in 2023 to 2025, the answer a EUR 100M restructuring and lobbying for safeguards and CBAM; the Americas lost money at EBIT 2016 to 2020, its 2025 recovery credited by the company to the 50% U.S. duties; operating margin the lowest of the three European majors in every year read (group 3.0% and Europe 2.2% over 2018 to 2025 against Aperam 6.6%; 3.3% against Acerinox 7.7% over 2020 to 2025), Aperam and Acerinox read from their own releases as non-SEC filers, Cleveland-Cliffs and ATI named by the company and not read; group ROCE 5.4% pre-tax over ten years. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: quarterly adjusted EBITDA guidance and run-rate targets reported as achieved, the Calvert wage-and-hour default judgment (about US$ 13M), a reported Rosatom claim in Moscow denied by the company, a 2025 fatality in Mexico. Owner cash (operating cash less capital spending, lease principal and stock pay) EUR 216M all-equity, 176M equity-only over 2021 to 2025, 175M and 112M over 2016 to 2020, from +608M (2022) to (66)M in 2024 and 2025. Balance sheets 2016 to 2025: net debt EUR 1.0bn to 1.2bn through 2020, near nothing in 2021 to 2022, EUR 224M now; equity down EUR 714M from the 2022 peak; the EUR 125M convertible became 47.0M new shares in 2025. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: all-equity range **EUR 11.73 to 17.22** against EUR 5.015 (equity-only 9.95 to 22.24), fair **EUR 4.91** all-equity, **EUR 5.50** equity-only, not armed, the box being OUT at Q2; the range high only because 3.76% capitalizes cyclical owner cash at about 27 times. A CONVENTION of the run: disposal proceeds not added to owner cash. Write-early: Step 0 to Q2 in one commit, declared. Contamination declared by the analyst: one filtered `Test Runs/` file-name listing for this name that returned nothing; commit subjects of another steel mill's run and two research-folder names in the git status, not opened; the map's implication that a v4.1 run exists, not opened. Commits a3ad45dd, 3f093a92, 9a1795db. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` clean (32 ids, 18 fragments); the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 32 ids, 14 quoted cites, no missing id, no E-id, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) the parts threshold says operating profit without saying reported or adjusted, and here the deciding part turns on the word; (2) no rule for an internal supplier segment (Ferrochrome sells mostly to Europe at internal prices); (3) specific (c) silent on a company that only sells businesses; (4) no cost per tonne from any rival, margins stand in; (5) at a 3.76% sovereign the cycle-averaged range sits two to three times above the price for a business Q2 finds high-cost. Could not get: Acerinox 2018 to 2019, Aperam 2016 to 2017, stock pay in four years and lease principal 2016 to 2018 (labelled guesses), interest paid 2016 to 2018, the 2022 to 2024 buyback prices.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: Europe decides on a knife edge (34.4% of 2021 to 2025 reported EBIT against the Americas' 33.5%; on adjusted EBIT the Americas would decide, both castles open), a high-cost producer whose price Asian imports set in the filer's words, share lost 31% to 28% in 2025, EBIT negative 2023 to 2025; operating margin the lowest of the three European majors every year read, 3.0% over 2018 to 2025 against Aperam 6.6%, 3.3% against Acerinox 7.7% over 2020 to 2025; the Americas behind the 50% U.S. duties. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: adjusted EBITDA guidance, the Calvert wage judgment, a Rosatom claim denied. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: all-equity range EUR 11.73 to 17.22 against EUR 5.015, fair EUR 4.91 all-equity, EUR 5.50 equity-only, not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: reported or adjusted operating profit in the parts threshold; internal supplier segments; disposals under specific (c).
